item.title: Melania Trump challenges Congress to make her foster care executive order permanent law: 'Their birthright'
item.summary: Melania Trump called for action over awareness, urging bipartisan lawmakers to pass permanent legislation supporting America's foster care community.

item.title: Allies rush thousands of drones to Ukraine as Russia unleashes deadly missile barrages
item.summary: Ukraine's allies pledge massive military aid, including 120,000 U.K. drones, as Russia launches 324 drones and ballistic missiles, officials report.

item.title: FIFA President Gianni Infantino says Iran will 'for sure' play in World Cup despite conflict involving US
item.summary: FIFA President Gianni Infantino said Iran is "for sure" competing in the 2026 World Cup despite the ongoing Middle East conflict involving the U.S.

item.title: Alleged ISIS-inspired terror suspects left feds ‘voluminous’ digital trail, family breaks down in tears
item.summary: Two men accused of hurling homemade bombs outside NYC's Gracie Mansion in an alleged ISIS-inspired attack pleaded not guilty to federal charges Wednesday.

item.title: Police flood Orange Crush island hot spot, warn of teen takeovers as beach bash madness returns
item.summary: Tybee Island braces for Orange Crush weekend with a heavy law enforcement presence amid concerns over unpermitted teen takeover events and gunfire.

item.title: Nine dead, 13 wounded in second Turkish mass shooting in two days
item.summary: A 14-year-old boy allegedly shot and killed nine people at a Turkish middle school, the second school shooting in Turkey in just two days.

item.title: Duke suspends Students for Justice in Palestine following complaints over antisemitic Instagram post
item.summary: Duke suspended its SJP chapter after complaints about a flyer some claimed was antisemitic, depicting pigs with Stars of David and Israeli flags.

item.title: Carrie Underwood surprises 'American Idol' contestant with Tiffany jewelry and handwritten note
item.summary: Carrie Underwood surprised "American Idol" contestant Hannah Harper with Tiffany jewelry and a heartfelt handwritten note of congratulations.

item.title: UN filing accuses UK of forced displacement as Diego Garcia tensions and security fears grow
item.summary: U.K. Prime Minister Keir Starmer faces a crimes against humanity complaint at the U.N. over the alleged forced removal of Chagossian people from the Diego Garcia islands.

item.title: ODNI sends criminal referrals to DOJ for ex-IG, whistleblower tied to Trump impeachment
item.summary: Fox News Digital learned the Office of the Director of National Intelligence sent criminal referrals for the whistleblower whose allegations led to the 2019 impeachment of President Donald Trump.
